caption: The drawing depicts two separate objects, both rendered in shades of gold and brown on a beige background. The object on the left consists of a rounded top piece, below which are three nested, marquise-shaped frames arranged vertically, each frame containing a solid, leaf-like shape. Small spherical drops hang from the intersections and bottom tips of the frames, totaling five spherical ornaments. The object on the right starts with a round ball fixed to a short horizontal arm and support, from which a vertical rod extends downward. Along the rod are three gold circles of increasing diameter arranged in descending order, each circle suspended around the rod, with small beads hanging from the centers of the two upper circles and a slightly larger sphere at the bottom. Both objects are detailed in gold with slight shading to suggest three-dimensionality and metallic texture, and are positioned side by side, with ample space between them against a plain background.
title: Earrings
